name: "DUAS CASAS" Puppet Show
description: Delight the whole family with this charming and imaginative puppet show, a perfect weekend activity just across the river in Vila Nova de Gaia.
longDescription:
"DUAS CASAS" is a puppet show designed for a family audience, presented by a local theatre company. The performance utilizes traditional puppetry techniques to tell a story through visual narrative and character interaction. The production aims to engage younger viewers with imaginative storytelling.

Attendees can expect an engaging performance suitable for children and adults. The show takes place at Sala Estúdio IG in Gaia, an intimate studio space. The duration of the performance is suitable for a family outing.

The event is scheduled for 2026-05-09. Tickets are available for purchase. Sala Estúdio IG is located in Vila Nova de Gaia, accessible from Porto via the D. Luís I Bridge, and within walking distance from Jardim do Morro metro station.
